params.body:
Since 4 November 2026, `composer audit --locked` (the check "Dependencies carry no new advisory") fails on main, and so on every pull request. It reports ten advisories against Symfony 8.1.9 in symfony/filesystem, http-foundation, http-kernel, routing and serializer, all fixed in 8.1.11. #1071 merged with that check red, and #1072 shows the same failure.

**What changes**: only `composer.lock`. The update ran `composer update "symfony/*" --with-dependencies`:
- patch releases within Symfony 8.1: the five affected packages and console, finder, property-access, property-info, translation and type-info go to 8.1.11; the rest go to 8.1.10;
- the Symfony contracts go to 3.8.1 and the polyfills to 1.43.3;
- phpstan/phpdoc-parser goes to 2.4.1 (dev only).

`composer.json` and laravel/framework (13.38.0) are untouched.

**Checks**
- `composer audit --locked`: no advisories.
- Full suite: 3209 tests OK.
- PHPStan: no errors.

Merging this turns the advisory check green on #1072 and on later pull requests.
params.title: Symfony 8.1.11: clear the ten advisories of 4 November 2026
